title: Product Description Writer
prompt: Write compelling product descriptions that highlight features, benefits, and unique selling points. Use persuasive language, address customer pain points, and include relevant details.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Produce audience-targeted product description content for a campaign with a clear call to action
Revise a draft product description asset for clarity, tone consistency, and stronger narrative flow
Package product description deliverables for publishing with headline, structure, and final polish
success_criteria: Draft has clear structure, audience fit, and consistent voice
Claims are supported and language is concise and error-free
Final product description output is publish-ready with minimal additional editing
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
